actionability.justification: The remedy specifies a concrete, checkable behavior change: run the declared verification command in-session and report the true result before claiming any fix/change is complete, which directly targets the observed failure of asserting success without running checks.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: Broadening from 'release' to any fix/repair/change/check claim covers the evidence cluster (test suites, lint, repairs) while still naming concrete artifacts (tests, lint, build, check) rather than collapsing into an empty platitude.

leakage.justification: The remedy text uses only generic terms (tests, lint, build, check) and omits the evidence quotes' idiosyncratic 'fake suite/lint/check' phrasing, so no evidence-specific nouns leak into the durable rule.

routing_fitness.justification: Consistent with the dedup analysis showing R1/R2/R6/R8 as the same overlapping failure mode, the proposal correctly merges into the cheaper always-loaded claude-md rule (R2) rather than spawning a redundant skill, matching prior merge precedent for this cluster.

trigger_quality.justification: As a claude-md rule rather than a skill it has no formal 'Use when...' clause, but the activating condition is stated plainly and unambiguously inline ('before reporting any fix, repair, change, or release as complete, passing, or verified').
